title: Minimum Moves to Balance Circular Array II
summary: One move transfers one unit from a person to either circular neighbor. Minimize moves until every balance is nonnegative. Multiple negative entries are allowed, and final balances need not be equal. Return -1 if impossible. There is no prescribed minimum-move formula in the statement.
officialConstraints: Official-page confirmation pending. See constraintsReportedBySource for the bounds in the community reproduction.
exampleStatus: No source examples copied. Author and independently validate teaching examples.
clarification: Derived feasibility: a negative total is impossible by conservation; a nonnegative total is sufficient because surplus can be routed along the connected ring. Authored example [3,-1,0,-2] needs three moves: send one unit from 0 to 1 and two from 0 to 3. Three deficit units give a matching lower bound.
